title: EC 1.2.4 · Random: score distributions
caption: Distribution of test-set scores for positives and negatives, EC 1.2.4 random split. The vertical line is the default decision threshold. SVM (RBF) on Conjoint triad: median score 0.81 for positives against -1.11 for negatives; Logistic regression on k-sep. bigram PSSM: median score 1.00 for positives against 0.00 for negatives.
